title: Smoky Butter Bean Dip with Sweet Peppers
intro: Silky and boldly spiced, this creamy dip uses tender butter beans to create a satisfying, high-fiber snack.

ingredients.name: Canned no-salt-added butter beans
ingredients.canonical_name: Lima beans, large, mature seeds, canned, no salt added

ingredients.name: Unsalted roasted pumpkin seeds (pepitas)
ingredients.canonical_name: Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, roasted, without salt added

instructions: Place the butter beans, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, and salt in a food processor or blender.
Blend on high speed until completely smooth and creamy, pulsing in the water if the mixture is too thick.
Transfer the dip to a serving bowl.
Garnish the surface with the roasted pumpkin seeds.
Serve immediately alongside the red bell pepper and carrots for dipping.
variation: Trade the smoked paprika for ground cumin and fresh cilantro.
conservation: Keeps up to 3 days refrigerated in an airtight container.
